Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147683648.loc: Guaranteed Loot: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Found just northeast of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Site of Grace, at the top of a waterfall (the top of the waterfall is on the same level as the Site of Grace). Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147683748.n: Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings
2147683748.loc: Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings is acquired upon defeating the Black Knight Edredd boss at the Fort of Reprimand, located in the southernmost point of Scadu Altus.

2147883648.n: Ash of War: Spinning Gravity Thrust
2147883648.loc: Loot:. Comes equipped to the Sword Lance, one of the possible rewards when trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

2147884648.loc: Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain. Equipped to the Dryleaf Arts given by Dryleaf Dane after defeating him in combat at the northwest section Moorth Ruins (requires the May the Best Win gesture). WARNING: Dane will disappear from this spot after the Sealing Tree in Ancient Ruins of Rauh is burnt. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147885648.loc: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus. Dropped by an explosive Teardrop Scarab found by one of the pillars just east of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. It's guarded by a small group of Misbegotten. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147886648.loc: Guaranteed Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Dropped by a hanging Teardrop Scarab found on a small pillar next to the foot of the large bridge south of Taylew's Ruined Forge. The pillar is one of the ones in the lower area of Rauh, on the eastern side of the road heading south from the Forge, and is just south of the bridge itself.

2147887648.n: Ash of War: Wall of Sparks
2147887648.loc: Guaranteed Loot: Shadow Keep. From the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace, head west to an elevator going down a floor. Take the first right exit and then the one out to a balcony on the left (guarded by an ambushing Hermit Jar Dweller) to find the item. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147888648.loc: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus. Dropped by a flying Scarab on top of a hill east of the northern parts of the Messmer Soldier encampment a bit south of Shadow Keep. Also directly south of the Shadow Keep Main Gate Site of Grace. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147889648.loc: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus. Dropped by a teleporting Teardrop Scarab found on a small hill east of the road leading north-northeast from the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and Bridge Leading to the Village Site of Grace. The Scarab is slightly visible from the road. The location is also southeast of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and northeast of Bonny Village.

2147890648.loc: Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain. Equipped to the Beast Claw, dropped by Logur, Beast Claw in southern Gravesite Plain. Found southeast of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace or far south of Scorched Ruins. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147892648.loc: Guaranteed Loot: Gravesite Plain. Found pre-equipped on the Backhand Blade, which is found in a small stone building north-northeast of Scorched Ruins or east-southeast of Three-Path Cross Site of Grace. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147893648.loc: Missable Loot: Shadow Keep. Given by Hornsent for using a golden summon sign to aid him against Needle Knight Leda when she invades him in Shadow Keep, on the battlements just before the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace. Given alongside Leda's Rune and is mutually exclusive with Ansbach's Longbow, Lacerating Crossed-Tree, and Retaliatory Crossed-Tree, and ends Leda's questline until Enir-Ilim.

2147894648.loc: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Found equipped to the Great Katana, which in turn is found in the middle of the lake in between Belurat Gaol and Abandoned Ailing Village. Guarded by a sleeping Ghostflame Dragon. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147895648.loc: Loot: Castle Ensis. Found in a chest in a small tower found by taking the east exit from the Castle-Lord's Chamber Site of Grace and then jumping over the north railing and falling down to the cliffside below. Continuing south and falling down three times more leads to the tower, and climbing to the top of it leads to the chest.

2147896648.loc: Guaranteed Loot: Fog Rift Catacombs. From the Fog Rift Catacombs Site of Grace proceed to the third room with a dropping, spiked ceiling. Reach the end of the room, being mindful of the hole in the second safe cubbyhole, and use the altar to jump into a hole in the spiked ceiling after it has fallen down. Jumping out of the hole once the ceiling is at the top leads to a platform with a chest holding the Ash of War.

2147897648.loc: Guaranteed Drop: Church of the Crusade or Belurat, Tower Settlement. Dropped by Fire Knight Queelign during his second invasion. If the first invasion was in Belurat, he will invade again when entering the Church of the Crusade.

2147898648.n: Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw
2147898648.loc: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Found in a small camp northwest of the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace and directly west of Run-Down Traveler's Rest. Head north along the cliff just west of the Site of Grace to find it more easily. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147899648.n: Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp
2147899648.loc: Trade the Remembrance of the Dancing Lion, dropped by the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method). Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147900648.loc: Guaranteed Drop: Shadow Keep. Dropped by Fire Knight Kood, along with the Winged Serpent Helm. He's found by climbing the statue in the middle of the sixth floor, most easily reached by heading north from the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace and dropping down a floor, then turning around and walking up the central pillar before crossing a statue to a doorway in the eastern wall.

2147901648.loc: Guaranteed Loot: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus). Dropped by a Scarab hanging from the roof of a cave southwest of Cathedral of Manus Metyr. The cave is found by heading further west when starting to take the road to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, and then heading as far south as possible along the plateau, keeping an eye on the left/to the east towards the end.

2147902648.n: Ash of War: Shriek of Sorrow
2147902648.loc: Guaranteed Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement. Found behind a statue in the middle of a plaza in Belurat. Head out the north door from the Small Private Altar Site of Grace, then head down the stairs east past a Horned Warrior, and finally go north to reach the plaza with the statue. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147905648.loc: Guaranteed drop: Charo's Hidden Grave. Dropped by a Death Rite Bird found in the body of water northwest of Charo's Hidden Grave Site of Grace. It only appears after approaching the big central grave. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2147988648.n: Ash of War: The Poison Flower Blooms Twice
2147988648.loc: Guaranteed Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found by starting at the Ravine North Site of Grace in Rauh Base, then heading south to cross the river and find it in a small pool of rot near some ruins (north of the large bridge above). Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

2148031648.n: Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt
2148031648.loc: Guaranteed Loot: Jagged Peak. Found on Igon's body if he was summoned to help kill Bayle the Dread (Igon needs to have been summoned for the successful attempt, but need not have survived). WARNING: This Ash of War will not be gained if Bayle is killed without Igon having been summoned, or if Igon is killed by the player.

2148283648.loc: Guaranteed Loot: Shadow Keep. Found pre-equipped to the Dueling Shield, which in turn is found by taking the stairs up on the other side of the statue at the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace then taking a left and going up the first stairs to the right. Continue on that path to another set of stairs to another floor up to find a balcony to the right.
